lookup.json.question: Tra cứu doanh thu thuần của NVL năm 2023.

compare.json.note: No gold70 question has this shape (two metrics, one company, one period); the fact (MSN 2025 current_assets and non_current_assets on the same table) is real, taken directly from the release.

compare_companies.json.note: Added in Day 16 (ADR 0005) for the (>=2 companies, 1 period, 1 metric) shape that the entity-cases two_companies template exercises but no Day 15 operation covered. Reuses the sum.json fact (GEX/PNJ net_revenue 2021) — same shape, juxtaposed instead of summed.

difference.json.note: No gold70 question has this shape (one metric, two periods, subtraction). Facts (VIB total_assets 2023/2024) are real, taken directly from the release.

growth_rate.json.question: Tính tốc độ tăng trưởng doanh thu thuần của NVL từ năm 2022 đến năm 2023.

ratio.json.note: No gold70 question asks for a ratio. Facts (PNJ 2015 net_revenue and total_assets, same table) are real, taken directly from the release.

average.json.note: No gold70 question asks for a multi-period average. Facts (VIB total_assets 2021-2023) are real, taken directly from the release.

sum.json.note: No gold70 question asks for a cross-company sum. Facts (GEX/PNJ net_revenue 2021) are real, taken directly from the release.

rank.json.note: No gold70 question asks for a ranking. Facts (GEX/PNJ/KHG net_revenue 2021) are real, taken directly from the release.
